newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity says Curvey is new COO.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity says Curvey is new COO.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said on Thursday that James Curvey had been named chief operating officer of the company, chairman of its operating committee and vice chairman of Fidelity's parent company FMR Corp.

In his new role, the company said in a statement, Curvey will supervise Fidelity's day-to-day operations, reporting to Chairman Edward Johnson. The company said the position was created as a response to recent growth.

Succeeding Curvey as president of Fidelity Capital, the business development arm of Fidelity, is Timothy Hilton, who served previously as managing director of Fidelity Capital, the company said in a statement.

Prior to joining Fidelity in 1982, Curvey, 61, was vice president of human resources for Chase Manhattan Corp's Chase Manhattan Bank, and prior to that post, he served as director of personnel for the Department of Housing and Urban Development, Fidelity said.
Hilton, 44, joined Fidelity Capital in April 1996 as a senior vice president and became a managing director in August.
Fidelity Investments is a mutual fund company and a provider of financial services.
